Every one of the 39 media/imageN.png md5s was re-hashed against its claimed source: 37 byte-identical, image12/image14 orphan (md5 a27b91c9… / 5967dab8…) as stated; the two-source claim for image25 (charged and elapsed effort dirs both 8ca0604e…) holds. Sites 0, 3, 8, 9, 14-27 and 39 confirmed verbatim, including recomputation of every 'new_value' the inventory gave: 2 Å rank-1 49.2/43.6/18.8 (149/132/57), top-15 70.3/59.1/27.4 (213/179/83), top-30 70.6/60.4/27.4, the full 1-5 Å grid, qualifying 214/183/83 with 54 shared, pose-level 4 Å reach 183->241/172->225/137->144 (rank-1, no PB gate) and 86->91/81->86/50->52 (top-15) all reproduce exactly from nearest_copy_alldepths.csv. The substantive corrections: (a) the six ladder arms and a kabsch_nearest column already exist in the plan's scratch evidence base, so Figs 3 and 18-21 have derivable targets rather than 'recompute' (given above); (b) the cluster cache is keyed on the per-pose CSV fingerprint, not the out-dir, and the real trap is a code-only change with an unbumped _CACHE_SCHEMA; (c) plan Sections 3/4 mislabel image24/image25 as Figs 10/11 (they are 15/16).
